# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

Follow `CLAUDE.md` in the repository root: it is the single rule set for every AI assistant in this project.
Decisions live in `docs/ru/decisions/README.md` (index) and its block files; do not contradict them and do not invent new rules.
Device labels are English, documents are Russian. Code AGPL-3.0, hardware CERN-OHL-S-2.0.
Do not edit generated KiCad files by hand: change the generator in `hardware/<board>/gen/` instead.
